## Weekly Plan (Lectures)

The plan below is **tentative** and will be adjusted as the semester progresses. Slides marked *Lec n* are from [CS1100, IIT Madras](./cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/index.qmd), reused with permission — see [acknowledgements](./index.qmd#acknowledgements). Additional notes will be posted as we go.

Each week's page carries Pre-read, In-Class, and After-Class sections — and ends with **PAGAL Notes** (*Perspectives on Algorithms, Generative AI & Learning*): an informal, blog-style weekly column on how that week's material looks in the age of AI.

| Week | Dates (Mon, Tue) | Topics | Materials |
|:---:|---|---|---|
| [01](weeks/w01.qmd) | Aug 3, Aug 4 | Introduction: computer science, algorithms, computer hardware & software | [Lec 1](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec1.pdf) · [Lec 3](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec3.pdf) |
| [02](weeks/w02.qmd) | Aug 10, Aug 11 | *Mon:* the computer revisited — von Neumann architecture, the Toy Computer (stored programs vs calculators). *Tue:* number systems — radix-q, binary & hex, conversions; signed integers; fixed & floating point, IEEE FP32 | [Deck 04](materials/w02-deck-04-computer-revisited.html) · [Toy Computer](materials/w02-toy-computer.html) · [Under the Hood 1–3](materials/w02-under-the-hood-1-parts.html) · [Deck 03](materials/w02-deck-03-number-systems.html) · [Lec 3](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec3.pdf) |
| [03](weeks/w03.qmd) | Aug 17, Aug 18 | *Mon:* one's & two's complement worked; overflow. *Tue:* first C program — write/compile/run, gcc and ./ annotated, variables, `%d`. *CT-1 window opens Aug 19* | [Deck 05](materials/w03-deck-05-complements-overflow.html) · [Deck 06](materials/w03-deck-06-first-c-program.html) · [Lec 3](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec3.pdf) · [Lec 4](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec4.pdf) |
| [04](weeks/w04.qmd) | Aug 24, Aug 25 | Programming types (declarative, imperative); structure of a C program; our first C program | [Lec 4](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec4.pdf) |
| [05](weeks/w05.qmd) | Aug 31, Sep 1 | Compilation pipeline: source, assembly and object files, linker, loader; compiler vs. interpreter | [Lec 6](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec6.pdf) |
| [06](weeks/w06.qmd) | Sep 7, Sep 8 | Data & expressions: literals, variables, identifiers, data types; operators, precedence; `printf`/`scanf` | [Lec 5](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec5.pdf) |
| [07](weeks/w07.qmd) | Sep 14, Sep 15 | Control structures: boolean expressions, selection (`if`, `if-else`, `switch`) | [Lec 7](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec7.pdf) · [Lec 8](cs1100-cse-iitm-2021/slides/Lec8.pdf) |
| [08](weeks/w08.qmd) | Sep 21, Sep 22 | **Mid-Semester Examinations (Sep 18–23) — no classes** | — |
